description: Sets, replaces or clears the photo of the host on the registration page and in the registration animation. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. Participants see the new face on their next visit. Needs `session_id` and `webinar_id` from wi_list_webinars, plus ONE of: `media_url` (an image from the media library, find it with wi_find_media), `wp_user_id` (that person's avatar, find the id with wi_find_wordpress_user) or `clear` true to remove the photo. The site reads the stored photo back, so report only what the answer names. Never invent an image address.

clear.description: true removes the photo, so the site shows the avatar or a monogram instead.

media_url.description: The image to use, from the host's own media library.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

wp_user_id.description: Use this WordPress user's avatar as the host photo.

name: wi_change_host_photo
title: Change the host photo of a webinar
